mcpServer.title: Agent access (MCP)
mcpServer.intro: External agents such as Claude Code and Cursor can read this project's PRD, PLAN and custom documents live, and propose changes. Every proposed change appears as a diff that a project member must approve, and business documents are never exposed.
mcpServer.snippetHint: Replace YOUR_TOKEN with a token created below. Check your IDE's documentation if its configuration format has changed.
